name: Troupe Tales: The Runaway Circus
source:
Roll up, roll up! Get to know an arrogant acrobat, a caring cowboy, a meek magician, and a colourful clown. Will you save the circus or doom it?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
快来瞧，快来看！傲气十足的杂技演员、体贴的牛仔、腼腆的魔术师和活灵活现的小丑，都等着和你见面。你会救下马戏团，还是让它走向毁灭？

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]］
